data.name: Backrooms: The Void
data.detailed_description:
Backrooms: The Void is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Trapped in an endless emptiness where space feels alive and reality constantly distorts, you must navigate decaying corridors, forgotten places, and impossible structures while something unseen follows your every move.

Play alone or with friends as you search for a way out, manage limited resources, and survive encounters within a world that grows more unstable the deeper you go.

Warning: This game punishes those who simply want to charge headlong without thinking or using tactics. Every sound in the game matters—you’ll pay the price for it. Play carefully with your friends!

Features

  • Unsettling and immersive atmosphere

  • Online Co-op

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Intelligent and adaptive enemy AI

  • Multiple difficulty settings

  • Stealth-based survival mechanics

  • Massive interconnected environments

  • Exploration-driven gameplay with constant tension

  • Dynamic visibility system influenced by movement, posture, darkness, and flashlight usage

Important Notes

This game is an original interpretation inspired by the Backrooms concept and does not strictly follow established community lore. It focuses on psychological tension, environmental storytelling, and unpredictable exploration to create a unique horror experience.

The game contains flickering lights, disturbing imagery, loud sounds, and intense audiovisual effects that may affect sensitive players.
